purpose: Teach: 負わ/乗ら/みせる/欠い/破れ/つっ/貼ら/吐く

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活、負担を負わせちゃってる、後輩に。
lines.en: I think I've been putting too much on the juniors.
lines.style: Quiet, self-critical admission. Soft opening. Brief pause after the thought, like she's still deciding if she should have said it out loud.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。電車、乗らないで、自転車で。
lines.en: Yeah. I've been biking instead of taking the train.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, no self-pity. Acknowledging without explaining. Warm but brief — he gets it already.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、作品、みせる時、緊張する。
lines.en: When it comes time to show our pieces at the festival, I get nervous.
lines.style: Genuine vulnerability breaking through. Slower pace. Not looking for reassurance, just naming the feeling.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部費、少し欠いた状況、相談しよう。
lines.en: The club budget's a bit short. We should probably talk about it.
lines.style: Practical, level-headed. No drama. Light problem-solve tone — he's offering a solution, not spiraling.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 制服、ボタンが破れたの、繕わなきゃ。
lines.en: My uniform button broke. I need to sew it back on.
lines.style: Slight edge of dark humor underneath. Resigned but not defeated. The tone of someone who sees one more small thing on her list.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 机につっかい棒、入れて、安定させた。
lines.en: I put a stick under the desk leg to stabilize it.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Almost conversational, like he's thinking out loud. No judgment — just what he did.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ステッカー、まだ貼らない、貼り直したいから。
lines.en: I haven't stuck the sticker on yet. I want to get the placement right.
lines.style: Softer, almost tentative. Like she's taking her time with something small because she can. Thoughtful, not rushed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 疲れた時、本音を吐く時間、大事だよ。
lines.en: When you're worn out, having time to say what's really going on — that matters.
lines.style: Steady, almost gentle. No performative warmth. Direct truth delivered like a small gift. Slight warmth on the final word.
